title: Psychedelic Praying Mantis
description: A vibrant green praying mantis stands prominently in the center, its body detailed with intricate patterns and large compound eyes. It is surrounded by a swirling cosmic background of colorful spirals, glowing orbs, and a large mosaic-like circular pattern beneath it with flames in fiery hues rising from the bottom right.
prompt: A highly detailed green praying mantis with intricate patterns and large compound eyes stands in a dynamic pose at the center of a cosmic psychedelic scene. Swirling spirals, glowing colorful orbs, and intricate mosaic circular patterns in blues and greens fill the background. Bright flames in orange, pink, and yellow rise from the bottom right, creating a surreal and mystical atmosphere.
